activities.name: Bijagós islands by boat
activities.note: ferry schedules depend on tides and weather, so check in advance

windows.reason: dry season: fast boats run when there is demand, and a liveaboard tours the two national parks weekly
the rains: fast boats and the weekly park cruise are dry-season services, leaving the once-weekly ferry

activities.name: Green turtle nesting (Poilão)
activities.note: the island is sacred and only a small number of visitors may land

windows.reason: the nesting season on sacred Poilão, one of the largest green turtle colonies in the Atlantic

activities.name: Travelling in the harmattan
activities.note: the dry-season wind off the Sahara; nothing closes, but expect dusty, very dry air

windows.reason: harmattan dust off the Sahara can block the sun for days and cut visibility like fog
the edges of the harmattan, which blows from late November to mid-March
